{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE cur_inv AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM (
    SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn
    FROM inventories
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
-- recursive explosion: track inventory id and accumulated quantity
walk AS (
  SELECT ci.id AS inv_id, 1 AS qty
  FROM sets s JOIN cur_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
  WHERE s.year = 2023
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ci.id, w.qty * isn.quantity
  FROM walk w
  JOIN inventory_sets isn ON isn.inventory_id = w.inv_id
  JOIN cur_inv ci ON ci.set_num = isn.set_num
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ci.id, w.qty * imf.quantity
  FROM walk w
  JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = w.inv_id
  JOIN cur_inv ci ON ci.set_num = imf.fig_num
)
SELECT SUM(w.qty * ip.quantity) AS total
FROM walk w
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = w.inv_id
JOIN parts p ON p.part_num = ip.part_num
JOIN colors c ON c.id = ip.color_id
WHERE ip.part_num = '41682' AND c.name = 'Dark Azure' AND ip.is_spare = FALSE"}

    FROM inventories i

    LIMIT 1
),
exploded AS (

    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.item_id

    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'minifig', im.fig_num, im.quantity * e.quantity, e.level + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.item_id
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'part', ip.part_num, ip.quantity * e.quantity, e.level + 1

    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.item_id

        ai.nesting_level + 1

    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = i1.id

WITH RECURSIVE 
base_parts(part_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '80014-1' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)
    AND ip.is_spare = false
),

base_sets(set_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT iset.set_num, iset.quantity
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    WHERE iset.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '80014-1' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)
),

base_minifigs(fig_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT im.fig_num, im.quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    WHERE im.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '80014-1' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)
),

-- Get all nested set inventories expanded
set_inventories(set_num, inventory_id) AS (
    SELECT s.set_num, i.id
    FROM base_sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = s.set_num)
),

-- Parts from nested sets (level 1)
set_parts(part_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT ip.part_num, bs.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM base_sets bs
    JOIN set_inventories si ON bs.set_num = si.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON si.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),

-- Nested sets within nested sets (level 2)
set_sets(set_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT iset.set_num, bs.quantity * iset.quantity
    FROM base_sets bs
    JOIN set_inventories si ON bs.set_num = si.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON si.inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
),

-- Minifigs in nested sets
set_minifigs(fig_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT im.fig_num, bs.quantity * im.quantity
    FROM base_sets bs
    JOIN set_inventories si ON bs.set_num = si.set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON si.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
),

-- Level 2 set inventories
set2_inventories(set_num, inventory_id) AS (
    SELECT ss.set_num, i.id
    FROM set_sets ss
    JOIN inventories i ON ss.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ss.set_num)
),

-- Parts from level 2 sets
set2_parts(part_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT ip.part_num, ss.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM set_sets ss
    JOIN set2_inventories si ON ss.set_num = si.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON si.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),

-- Minifig inventories
minifig_inventories(fig_num, inventory_id) AS (
    SELECT bm.fig_num, i.id
    FROM base_minifigs bm
    JOIN inventories i ON bm.fig_num = i.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = bm.fig_num)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sm.fig_num, i.id
    FROM set_minifigs sm
    JOIN inventories i ON sm.fig_num = i.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = sm.fig_num)
),

-- Parts from minifigs
minifig_parts(part_num, quantity) AS (
    SELECT ip.part_num, bm.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM base_minifigs bm
    JOIN minifig_inventories mi ON bm.fig_num = mi.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON mi.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ip.part_num, sm.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM set_minifigs sm
    JOIN minifig_inventories mi ON sm.fig_num = mi.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON mi.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)

SELECT 
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM base_parts WHERE part_num = '43093'), 0) +
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM set_parts WHERE part_num = '43093'), 0) +
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM set2_parts WHERE part_num = '43093'), 0) +
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM minifig_parts WHERE part_num = '43093'), 0) 
    AS total_units"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get the current inventory for set 6427871-1
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '6427871-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with the set's inventory, multiplier = 1
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        '6427871-1' AS item_id
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in an inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        e.multiplier * ip.quantity AS multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets in an inventory
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        e.multiplier * iset.quantity AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND i.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = iset.set_num
      )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs in an inventory
    SELECT

-- Get current inventory for a given set_num
current_inv(set_num, inv_id) AS (
    SELECT set_num, id
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),

-- Recursive explosion of all parts
exploded(inv_id, part_num, qty) AS (
    -- Direct parts from the starting inventory (excluding spares)
    SELECT ip.inventory_id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inv_id FROM current_inv WHERE set_num = '10249-1')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from nested sets (multiply by quantity of nested sets)
    SELECT 
        ci.inv_id,
        ip.part_num,
        e.qty * iset.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inv_id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifigs (multiply by quantity of minifigs)
    SELECT 
        ci.inv_id,
        ip.part_num,
        e.qty * im.quantity * ip.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inv_id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT part_num) as distinct_part_numbers
FROM exploded
"}

  -- Base: direct parts from the set's inventory

    'part' AS item_type,
    CAST(ip.part_num AS VARCHAR) AS item_id,
    ip.color_id AS color_id,
    ip.quantity AS qty
  FROM inventory_parts ip
  JOIN current_inventory ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
  WHERE ip.is_spare = false
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Base: nested sets from the set's inventory
  SELECT 
    'set' AS item_type,
    CAST(iset.set_num AS VARCHAR) AS item_id,
    NULL AS color_id,
    iset.quantity AS qty
  FROM inventory_sets iset
  JOIN current_inventory ci ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Base: minifigs from the set's inventory
  SELECT 
    'minifig' AS item_type,
    CAST(im.fig_num AS VARCHAR) AS item_id,

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find the current inventory for set 41125-1
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '41125-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with the set's inventory, quantity multiplier = 1
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        '41125-1' AS item_id
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in an inventory (including spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity,
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set' OR e.item_type = 'minifig'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets in an inventory
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * iset.quantity,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    -- Get current inventory version for nested set
    AND i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = iset.set_num
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs in an inventory
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * im.quantity,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
),
-- Get all parts from the exploded tree
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity AS total_qty,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.is_spare
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
SELECT SUM(total_qty) AS total_parts_including_spares
FROM all_parts
WHERE is_spare = TRUE OR is_spare = FALSE
"}

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get all set inventories and their current versions
set_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (set_num) id, set_num, version
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY set_num, version DESC
),
-- Recursive expansion: we track the root set and what item we're currently expanding
-- The item can be a set_num (from inventory_sets) or fig_num (from inventory_minifigs)
-- We need to track both the root set and the current inventory we're expanding
exploded AS (
    -- Base: all sets with their current inventory parts
    SELECT 
        si.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        CAST(ip.quantity AS BIGINT) AS qty
    FROM set_inventories si
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = si.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: inventory_sets points to another set, which has its own inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        e.qty * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM set_inventories WHERE set_num = e.part_num
    )
    JOIN set_inventories si ON si.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = si.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    AND e.part_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM set_inventories)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: inventory_minifigs points to a fig, which has its own inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        e.qty * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM set_inventories WHERE set_num = e.part_num
    )
    JOIN inventories mi ON mi.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mi.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    AND e.part_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM set_inventories)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_set) AS num_sets
FROM exploded
WHERE part_num = '92198pr0349'

    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),

-- Recursive expansion of set contents
-- We track: root_set (the top-level set we're exploring from), current inventory being expanded, item type, item id, quantity multiplier
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start from all sets' current inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num as root_set,
        ci.id as inv_id,
        'set' as item_type,
        ci.set_num as item_id,
        1 as qty
    FROM current_inventories ci
    WHERE ci.set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)  -- only actual sets, not minifigs
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.inventory_id as inv_id,
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.part_num as item_id,
        e.qty * ip.quantity as qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'  -- expand parts from set inventories
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci2.id as inv_id,
        'set' as item_type,
        ci2.set_num as item_id,
        e.qty * iset.quantity as qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci2.id as inv_id,
        'minifig' as item_type,
        ci2.set_num as item_id,
        e.qty * im.quantity as qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifig inventories
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.inventory_id as inv_id,
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.part_num as item_id,
        e.qty * ip.quantity as qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig'  -- expand parts from minifig inventories
      AND ip.is_spare = false
),

    SELECT DISTINCT root_set
    FROM exploded
    WHERE item_type = 'part'

)

    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON s.theme_id = th.id
    WHERE s.year = 2016
),
-- Find current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents (parts, nested sets, minifigs)
-- Start with sets in theme
exploded AS (
    -- Base: sets in the theme with multiplier 1
    SELECT 
        sit.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.inventory_id,
        1::BIGINT AS quantity_multiplier
    FROM sets_in_theme sit
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON sit.set_num = ci.set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets: inventory_sets points to another set's inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci2.inventory_id,
        e.quantity_multiplier * iset.quantity AS quantity_multiplier
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON e.inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON iset.set_num = ci2.set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs: they have their own inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci3.inventory_id,
        e.quantity_multiplier * im.quantity AS quantity_multiplier
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci3 ON im.fig_num = ci3.set_num
),
-- Get all parts from all exploded inventories
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        e.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
-- Sum all quantities across all sets
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0) AS total_parts

    -- Get 'Advent' theme and all its sub-themes recursively
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Advent'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
-- Get all sets in Advent theme and sub-themes released in 2020
advent_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON s.theme_id = tt.id
    WHERE s.year = 2020
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
-- Recursive CTE to get all parts from sets, nested sets, and minifigs
recursive_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from set inventories (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN advent_sets a ON ci.set_num = a.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.inventory_id = ip.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: recurse into inventory_sets
    SELECT 
        rp.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * iset.quantity AS quantity
    FROM recursive_parts rp
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = rp.part_num  -- rp.part_num holds the set_num for nested sets
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON ci.inventory_id = iset.id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci2.inventory_id = ip.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: recurse into minifig inventories
    SELECT

    -- Find the 'Books' theme and all its descendants
    SELECT id, name, parent_id

    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
set_inventories AS (
    -- Get current inventory for each set in Books theme (including sub-themes)
    SELECT 
        s.set_num,
        s.name,
        i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON s.theme_id = tt.id
    JOIN inventories i ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE s.year = 2022
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = s.set_num)
),

exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with each set's direct inventory
    SELECT 
        si.set_num AS root_set,
        si.inventory_id,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        si.set_num AS item_id
    FROM set_inventories si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from inventories (leaf level)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        NULL AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: need to expand their inventories
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * iset.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON e.inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON iset.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = iset.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: need to expand their inventories
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * im.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON im.fig_num = i.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find all sets released in 2015
sets_2015 AS (
    SELECT set_num FROM sets WHERE year = 2015
),
-- Current inventory for each set/minifig
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
-- Recursive expansion: start with sets from 2015, then expand nested sets and minifigs
-- We track: the root set, the current item being expanded, quantity multiplier, item type
exploded AS (
    -- Base: sets from 2015 with their current inventory
    SELECT 
        s.set_num as root_set,
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        1 as qty_multiplier,
        'set' as item_type
    FROM sets_2015 s
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: each nested set contributes its own inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * iset.quantity as qty_multiplier,
        'set' as item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')  -- sets can contain nested sets and minifigs
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: each minifig contributes its own inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * im.quantity as qty_multiplier,
        'minifig' as item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')  -- sets can contain minifigs
),
-- Get all parts from all expanded inventories
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity as total_qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT SUM(total_qty) as total_part_54200_orange
FROM all_parts
WHERE part_num = '54200' AND color_id = 25

        FROM inventories

),

    SELECT s.set_num

    JOIN theme_tree tt ON s.theme_id = tt.id
    WHERE s.year = 2013
),

    -- Base: direct parts from set inventories (non-spare)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN advent_sets a ON ci.set_num = a.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

    JOIN advent_sets a ON ci.set_num = a.set_num

    WHERE ip.is_spare = false

        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        rc.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON rc.part_num IS NULL  -- This approach won't work, need to restructure
)

-- Get all sets in Books theme and sub-themes, with their current inventory

    SELECT s.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM sets s
    INNER JOIN theme_tree tt ON s.theme_id = tt.id
    INNER JOIN inventories i ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    WHERE s.year = 2024
    AND i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = s.set_num
    )
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at all levels
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from set inventories
    SELECT si.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM set_inventories si
    INNER JOIN inventory_parts ip ON si.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from nested sets (inventory_sets)
    SELECT ep.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    INNER JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ep.part_num = ins.set_num  -- part_num holds the nested set_num here
    INNER JOIN inventories i ON ins.set_num = i.set_num
    INNER JOIN inventory_parts ip ON i.id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
    AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifigs
    SELECT ep.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    INNER JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ep.part_num = im.fig_num  -- part_num holds the fig_num here
    INNER JOIN inventories i ON im.fig_num = i.set_num
    INNER JOIN inventory_parts ip ON i.id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)

)

-- Start with inventory version 2 of set 71741-1
base_inventory AS (
  SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '71741-1' AND version = 2
),

-- Recursive CTE: track item type, item id, and accumulated quantity multiplier
-- item_type: 'part', 'set', 'minifig'
-- item_id: part_num, set_num, or fig_num
-- color_id: for parts only
-- qty_multiplier: product of quantities along the path
exploded(item_type, item_id, color_id, qty_multiplier) AS (
  -- Direct parts from base inventory (non-spare)
  SELECT 
    'part' AS item_type,
    ip.part_num AS item_id,
    ip.color_id,
    ip.quantity AS qty_multiplier
  FROM inventory_parts ip
  WHERE ip.inventory_id IN (SELECT id FROM base_inventory)
    AND ip.is_spare = false
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Nested sets from base inventory
  SELECT 
    'set' AS item_type,
    iset.set_num AS item_id,
    NULL AS color_id,
    iset.quantity AS qty_multiplier
  FROM inventory_sets iset
  WHERE iset.inventory_id IN (SELECT id FROM base_inventory)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Minifigs from base inventory
  SELECT 
    'minifig' AS item_type,
    im.fig_num AS item_id,
    NULL AS color_id,
    im.quantity AS qty_multiplier
  FROM inventory_minifigs im
  WHERE im.inventory_id IN (SELECT id FROM base_inventory)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursive: expand sets - get their current inventory's parts
  SELECT 
    'part' AS item_type,
    ip.part_num AS item_id,
    ip.color_id,
    e.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity AS qty_multiplier
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = e.item_id
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id)
    AND ip.is_spare = false
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursive: expand sets - get their nested sets
  SELECT 
    'set' AS item_type,
    iset.set_num AS item_id,
    NULL AS color_id,
    e.qty_multiplier * iset.quantity AS qty_multiplier
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = e.item_id
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = inv.id
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursive: expand sets - get their minifigs
  SELECT 
    'minifig' AS item_type,
    im.fig_num AS item_id,
    NULL AS color_id,
    e.qty_multiplier * im.quantity AS qty_multiplier
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = e.item_id
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = inv.id
  WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    AND inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recursive: expand minifigs - get their current inventory's parts
  SELECT 
    'part' AS item_type,
    ip.part_num AS item_id,
    ip.color_id,
    e.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity AS qty_multiplier
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = e.item_id
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
  WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig'
    AND inv.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id)
    AND ip.is_spare = false
)

-- Sum all quantities for parts
SELECT SUM(qty_multiplier) AS total_parts
FROM exploded
WHERE item_type = 'part'"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Start with version 1 of set 9494-1
base_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, 1 AS quantity
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '9494-1' AND i.version = 1
),

-- Recursive expansion of inventory contents
-- We track: inventory_id (current item being expanded), quantity multiplier, type of item
exploded AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from the base inventory
    SELECT 
        bi.inventory_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity * bi.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM base_inventory bi
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = bi.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: nested sets from the base inventory (need to expand)
    SELECT 
        bi.inventory_id,
        iset.set_num AS part_num,  -- using part_num column to store set_num temporarily
        iset.quantity * bi.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM base_inventory bi
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = bi.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: minifigs from the base inventory (need to expand)
    SELECT 
        bi.inventory_id,
        im.fig_num AS part_num,  -- using part_num column to store fig_num temporarily
        im.quantity * bi.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'minifig' AS item_type
    FROM base_inventory bi
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = bi.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets (use their CURRENT inventory)
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        iset2.set_num AS part_num,
        e.total_quantity * iset2.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.part_num AND e.item_type = 'set'
    -- Get current inventory (highest version)
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) curr ON curr.set_num = i.set_num AND i.version = curr.max_version
    JOIN inventory_sets iset2 ON iset2.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand minifigs (use their CURRENT inventory)
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        ip.part_num,
        e.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = e.part_num AND e.item_type = 'minifig'
    -- Get current inventory (highest version)
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) curr ON curr.set_num = i.set_num AND i.version = curr.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false AND e.item_type = 'minifig'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: parts from expanded sets (continue expanding nested sets and minifigs)
    -- Parts from set expansion
    SELECT 
        e.inventory_id,
        ip.part_num,
        e.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false AND e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets within expanded sets
    SELECT 
        e.inventory_id,
        iset.set_num AS part_num,
        e.total_quantity * iset.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs within expanded sets
    SELECT 
        e.inventory_id,
        im.fig_num AS part_num,
        e.total_quantity * im.quantity AS total_quantity,
        'minifig' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
)

-- Count distinct part numbers (ignoring color) from all parts at any level
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT part_num) AS distinct_part_numbers
FROM exploded
WHERE item_type = 'part'"}
